verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs show that evals can run in CI. They say to run evals on every pull request, integrate experiments into CI/CD to catch regressions, and run evals from the command line with `npx braintrust eval`. Gating deployments on those results is supported only by a homepage marketing line about blocking bad releases, with no documented mechanism behind it. missing for 10: documented deployment-gating mechanism (score thresholds, failing exit codes, or a CI action that blocks merges/deploys), CI setup docs or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI gating.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Automate in CI/CD — Run evals on every pull request to catch regressions
integrate into CI/CD to catch regressions before they reach production
lets you run experiments programmatically, and lets you integrate evals into your CI/CD pipeline
Catch issues early — Block bad releases before they hit production
